observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor stage at a festival or cultural event with banners and lighting
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, around twelve to fourteen dancers
observation.formation_and_space: curved line formation moving in unison across the stage
observation.posture: upright torso with knees slightly bent and weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: stepping side to side, crossing behind, and tapping feet on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held up with elbows bent, hands moving or holding objects like handkerchiefs
observation.hips_and_torso: slight upper body leaning and bouncing with the step rhythm
observation.partnering: none, group dancing side-by-side in a line
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level with occasional small hops and pivots
observation.costume_and_props: red tunics, white dhotis or trousers, yellow sashes, and headwraps; some holding small cloths
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot weight distribution and low-level details due to stage lighting and wide camera shot

signature_moments.what: Dancers form a curved line, stepping sideways in unison while holding props and waving arms overhead
